title: Explore Downtown Detroit Walking Tour: Architecture & History
includes: Mobile Listening Device for Use During Tour (to be returned to Operator at end of Tour)
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Not recommended for those that have difficulty with uneven surfaces
Not recommended for those that cannot walk at a moderate pace for over 1.5 miles.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the captivating history of downtown Detroit on this walking tour, tracing its evolution from a bustling hub to a city in recovery and back. Discover iconic sites such as Campus Martius, where Detroit's vision was born, and Griswold Street - the Wall Street of Detroit - lined with architectural marvels like the Guardian Building and the Penobscot. Delve into stories of resilience along Jefferson Avenue, discover the vibrant legacy of Black Bottom, and stroll through the historic Grand Circus Park and Capitol Park. This immersive experience reveals the cultural richness and transformative journeys of Detroit, guided by an expert storyteller and city planner.

- Walk through Detroit’s historic districts and landmarks
- Visit architectural gems like the Guardian and Dime Buildings
- Hear tales of the Underground Railroad and significant historical figures
- Enjoy a knowledgeable guide sharing local insights and stories
